decision_states.CONTINUE_SHADOW: the minimum live-evidence requirement is not yet met, or it is met and the gates are neither cleanly passed nor cleanly failed. Keep collecting. This is the default state and the only state a report may reach on its own.
decision_states.PROMOTION_REVIEW_ELIGIBLE: the minimum live-evidence requirement is met and every operational, proper-score and dependence gate passes at the frozen evaluation cut. This state means a human review may now be opened. It is not a promotion, it does not change the published authority, and no code path may act on it.
decision_states.SHADOW_DISABLED_FOR_SAFETY: an operational gate failed in a way that implicates the incumbent feed, or a shadow publishing violation was observed. The shadow step is disabled; the incumbent is unaffected because it never depended on the shadow.
decision_states.SHADOW_MODEL_REJECTED: the minimum live-evidence requirement is met and a proper-score or dependence gate fails with statistical support. The candidate does not become the published authority and this lineage closes.
decision_states.no_automatic_transition_to_published_aut: no code path may transition any state to published authority. PROMOTION_REVIEW_ELIGIBLE authorises human review only.

D1_global_latent_dependence_rmse.requirement: candidate live global latent dependence RMSE < incumbent live global latent dependence RMSE

D2_count_space_dependence_rmse.requirement: candidate live count-space dependence RMSE < incumbent live count-space dependence RMSE

D3_protected_buckets_may_not_worsen.requirement: no protected bucket may worsen by more than 1.0 z versus the incumbent on live evidence

D4_explicitly_reported_not_gated.requirement: reported explicitly in every live report, with the same z convention as the protected buckets. Reported, not gated.

retired_requirement.name: the arbitrary 20 per cent passer-AST count-space reduction
retired_requirement.why: the forensic study established that forcing the focal passer_ast_teammate_pts count-space correction far enough to clear 20 per cent requires a latent entry of 0.0508138 against a maximum feasible 0.0480072, and that teammate_reb_reb degrades by 8.27 per cent first. Its disposition is final and this policy does not reopen it.

evaluation.cut: the evaluation cut is frozen by the minimum live-evidence requirement, not chosen after inspecting results
evaluation.loss_delta_convention: delta = candidate - incumbent. Lower is better, so a negative delta is a candidate improvement.
evaluation.reference_comparison_only: candidate versus cross-player independence. Reported for context; it gates nothing.
evaluation.resampling: paired game-clustered bootstrap. Games are the resampling unit because joint-event rows within one game share the game's latent state and are not independent.

authorised_triggers_for_new_modelling_in.A_reproducible_correctness_bug: a defect that reproduces deterministically from recorded inputs
authorised_triggers_for_new_modelling_in.B_persistent_operational_failure: a repeated operational failure, including a repeated deterministic candidate fallback with one root cause even when the total fallback rate is within O4
authorised_triggers_for_new_modelling_in.C_statistically_supported_degradation: a degradation supported by the proper-score gates after the minimum live-evidence requirement is met
authorised_triggers_for_new_modelling_in.D_localised_dependence_miss: a clearly localised dependence miss supported by sufficient live sample in the affected bucket

failure_discipline.not_a_trigger: one bad week, one noisy bucket, or one unfavourable intermediate report does not reopen research

immutability.rule: this policy is immutable unless a correctness bug is discovered in it. Thresholds, the minimum sample, the seed and the gate list are fixed before any live result exists, which is what stops a threshold from being tuned to whatever the live sample happens to show.
immutability.what_counts_as_a_correctness_bug: a threshold that cannot be evaluated as written, a metric that does not exist, an internally contradictory gate, or a reference to a field the shadow log does not carry. A disappointing live result is not a correctness bug.

minimum_live_evidence.combination: A and B and C must all hold before any gate verdict is rendered
minimum_live_evidence.no_early_promotion: a favourable small sample does not shorten this requirement. Reports produced before the requirement is met are monitoring only and may not render a gate verdict.

O1_shadow_publishing_violations.evidence: rows_published and published on every shadow status and grading report

O2_psd_failures.evidence: psd_diagnostics minimum covariance eigenvalue per evaluated game

O3_same_player_block_deviation.scope: every evaluated game, not an average over games

O4_candidate_fallback_rate.repeated_root_cause_requires_review: any repeated deterministic candidate failure sharing one root cause requires review even when the total rate is below the threshold

O6_incumbent_serving_unaffected.requirement: no candidate failure may alter, delay or block an incumbent probability. The shadow fails open for the lifecycle and the served number is always the incumbent's.
O6_incumbent_serving_unaffected.verified_by: the deployed entry point catches its own failures and exits 0, the lifecycle step sets continue-on-error, and an incumbent failure propagates rather than being replaced by a candidate number

bootstrap.seed_provenance: the repository's established game-clustered bootstrap seed, used by transmission.bootstrap_source_pair and the remediation bootstraps

proper_score_gates.standard: aggregate improvement plus leg-level non-inferiority. Statistical superiority is NOT required on every leg count.

scope: SHADOW ONLY. The incumbent remains the served and published authority on every row. This policy decides what live evidence would make the candidate eligible for a human promotion review; it grants no promotion authority of its own and no code path may act on it.

artifact_identity: incumbent artifact hash and model version
tracked_metrics.dependence_buckets_note: the twelve cross-player buckets the validation layer reports are teammate_pts_pts, teammate_reb_reb, teammate_ast_ast, passer_ast_teammate_pts, teammate_pts_reb, teammate_fg3m_fg3m, opponent_pts_pts, opponent_reb_reb, opponent_pts_reb, opponent_fg3m_reb, opponent_ast_ast and opponent_stl_pts. All twelve are tracked every cut; the same-player blocks are tracked separately under O3 because they must be preserved exactly rather than improved.
proper_scores: brier by leg count for 2, 3 and 4 legs
log loss by leg count for 2, 3 and 4 legs

wizardofodds_activation.canary_required: publishing starts as a canary and the production output is verified before any wider enablement
wizardofodds_activation.not_built_in_this_task: no live publisher exists and none was built or enabled. publish_shadow_probabilities refuses regardless of switch state because there is no publisher behind it.
preconditions: a separate reviewed change implements the publisher
the publishing switch is enabled by that reviewed change
the activation SHA and activation time are recorded
